top_signals.title: Bond Traders Price in Two Fed Hikes This Year After CPI Report
top_signals.summary: Traders boosted expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike after hotter-than-expected core US inflation data, with a 90% chance of a move next week and two increases fully priced in by the end of the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
